nodes.label: IQA once per eye determines Good/Usable/Reject routing
nodes.norm_label: iqa once per eye determines good/usable/reject routing
nodes.rationale: Good grades and segments the original; Usable restores then grades and segments the restored image; Reject skips downstream models and requires recapture.

nodes.label: Explicit tensor/two-tensor output and optional CAM contract
nodes.norm_label: explicit tensor/two-tensor output and optional cam contract
nodes.rationale: Grade CAM defaults on; lesion CAM defaults off with opt-in. Scores/activation indices are explicit. Tensor-only outputs disable CAM; unusable gradients preserve warning behavior.

nodes.label: Canonical quality, grade and lesion channel/class mapping
nodes.norm_label: canonical quality, grade and lesion channel/class mapping
nodes.rationale: Explicit raw-order mapping yields Good/Usable/Reject, grades 0..4 and MA/HE/EX/SE. Fixed canonical typed arrays keep UI/reporting semantics stable.

nodes.label: Content-addressed successful model-contract cache
nodes.rationale: Model bytes, contract version, Torch version and CPU/CUDA kind identify successful validation markers. Failed validation is never cached and unwritable cache repeats validation.

nodes.label: Presence-based forced CPU and paired ONNX CPU fallback
nodes.norm_label: presence-based forced cpu and paired onnx cpu fallback
nodes.rationale: RETINAGRAM_FORCE_CPU presence, even value 0, forces CPU. ORT CUDA construction failure recreates both ONNX sessions on CPU while Torch may remain CUDA; this is initialization fallback.

nodes.label: ModelManager routing, mutex, progress and serialization boundary
nodes.norm_label: modelmanager routing, mutex, progress and serialization boundary
nodes.rationale: Initialization and complete analyses are serialized. Model filenames, sizes, precision, tuple/class assumptions and runtime tensor operations stay outside the manager.

nodes.label: Short-lived native helper isolates startup shape probes
nodes.norm_label: short-lived native helper isolates startup shape probes
nodes.rationale: Cache-miss validation precedes loading parent persistent models to preserve patient-process kernel initialization order. Contracts, not clinical accuracy or every shape/gradient topology, are validated.

nodes.label: Pillow-compatible bilinear RGB/NCHW preprocessing
nodes.rationale: Shared preprocessing preserves arithmetic and rounding. Configured input conversion does not cast model parameters or alter internal precision.

nodes.label: Persistent background model worker
nodes.rationale: Persistent runtime sessions/modules are reused across analyses without a Python server, Node or Electron runtime.

nodes.label: CPU LesionPostprocessor full masks and original-coordinate regions
nodes.norm_label: cpu lesionpostprocessor full masks and original-coordinate regions
nodes.rationale: Borrowed canonical CPU FP32 planes yield independent threshold-0.5 full masks. Eight-connected components, reference-scaled area filtering/proximity merging and display sorting preserve existing behavior independently of UI Top-K.

nodes.label: Historical startup crash from a null Cloud navigation pointer
nodes.norm_label: historical startup crash from a null cloud navigation pointer
nodes.rationale: Six center navigation buttons left Cloud null while the old package iterated seven pointers and called QObject::doSetProperty. Preserved null checks and redeployment repaired startup.

nodes.label: Matched viewport and centered native frontend geometry
nodes.norm_label: matched viewport and centered native frontend geometry
nodes.rationale: Reference viewport dimensions must match native canvases when assessing proportions; browser/Qt rasterization and physical work-area constraints limit exact pixel claims.

nodes.label: Native control/state fidelity with rendering and review limits
nodes.norm_label: native control/state fidelity with rendering and review limits
nodes.rationale: Qt/browser wrapping, borders and font rendering differ; Confirm/Flag keeps native status messages and Cloud remains disconnected. Functional/UI checks do not extend clinical validity.

nodes.label: Batch Pause/Resume/Cancel at image boundaries
nodes.rationale: Atomic flags and a condition variable allow the current image to finish; cancellation or resume wakes a paused worker.

nodes.label: Raw regions bypass class filtering and Top-K
nodes.norm_label: raw regions bypass class filtering and top-k
nodes.rationale: Selected boxes/cards share original-pixel coordinates; display downscaling preserves result coordinates and analysis data.

nodes.label: Annotation colors existing saved threshold masks
nodes.norm_label: annotation colors existing saved threshold masks
nodes.rationale: Visibility, opacity and class colors affect rendering only; the displayed threshold is not reapplied and missing CAM is not synthesized.

nodes.label: Canonical full masks copied byte for byte before display filtering
nodes.norm_label: canonical full masks copied byte for byte before display filtering
nodes.rationale: MA/HE/EX/SE export as microaneurysm.png, hemorrhage.png, hard_exudate.png and soft_exudate.png. Full-mask detection remains independent of Top-K, selected regions and zero display counts.

nodes.label: S6 implemented portable layout and relocation validation
nodes.norm_label: s6 implemented portable layout and relocation validation

nodes.label: ModelConfig version 1 and compatible model replacement
nodes.norm_label: modelconfig version 1 and compatible model replacement
nodes.rationale: All four stages remain required. Supported RGB/NCHW image contracts, dimensions/dtypes/normalization and explicit output/class mappings are validated; compatible artifacts in src/checkpoints can change through JSON and restart. New runtimes/tasks/classes/CAM mechanisms still require code. Flat artifact filenames are required; fixed image dimensions are bounded to 1..8192 and 16,000,000 pixels. Changing supported thresholds changes behavior and requires validation.

nodes.label: Historical root/checkpoints and RETINAGRAM_MODEL_CONFIG selection
nodes.rationale: The S2 record describes the former ../checkpoints layout and legacy environment-selected JSON. S6 supersedes this path selection with shared AppPaths, src/checkpoints and explicit CLI configuration.

nodes.label: AppPaths shared runtime root resolver
nodes.rationale: src/core/AppPaths.cpp and src/include/core/AppPaths.h serve model/UI/PDF resource discovery. Executable ancestors are searched before working-directory ancestors, bounded to five parents and requiring both config/models.json and src/checkpoints.

nodes.label: Current flat deployment artifacts under src/checkpoints
nodes.norm_label: current flat deployment artifacts under src/checkpoints
nodes.rationale: All four artifact sizes/SHA256 remain unchanged after relocation; no root/checkpoints fallback or numerical conversion is introduced.

nodes.label: Shared scripts/dependencies.ps1 bounded SDK discovery
nodes.rationale: Explicit SDK overrides, valid same-root caches and documented system/PATH locations locate VS x64, Qt, Torch, ORT and CUDA. Required files are validated; another RetinaGram checkout is never a fallback.

nodes.label: deploy.sh builds, packages and validates with Windows-only PATH
nodes.norm_label: deploy.sh builds, packages and validates with windows-only path
nodes.rationale: The shared workflow archives an unlocked previous package, creates a fresh package and checks all configured models. Success is printed only after validation; lower-level deploy-windows.ps1 packages an existing build and rejects nonempty destinations.

nodes.label: Legacy model-config environment ignored; explicit --model-config CLI selection
nodes.norm_label: legacy model-config environment ignored; explicit --model-config cli selection
nodes.rationale: Normal GUI/CLI uses resolved-root config/models.json. Advanced/testing CLI input is established before workers start; missing/duplicate arguments fail. ../src/checkpoints resolves relative to the selected JSON.

nodes.label: Former stale config environment selected another deployment root
nodes.norm_label: former stale config environment selected another deployment root
nodes.rationale: Legacy config selection could resolve IQA through another checkout or obsolete root/checkpoints. The reported IQA load failure was deployment-location selection, not model corruption or changed INT8 inference.

nodes.label: Package markers take precedence over enclosing checkout markers
nodes.norm_label: package markers take precedence over enclosing checkout markers
nodes.rationale: A package contains its own config/models.json, src/checkpoints and assets. The same JSON bytes and ../src/checkpoints path work in source and package layouts, including an unrelated working directory.

nodes.label: Fresh differently named checkout built and validated without source/config edits
nodes.norm_label: fresh differently named checkout built and validated without source/config edits
nodes.rationale: The relocation test resolved its own root/config/models through the same external SDKs. --no-build rejected an injected former-root cache; normal workflow archived/rebuilt it without using the original project as a fallback.

nodes.label: Validated RETINAGRAM_ROOT selects an explicit application root
nodes.norm_label: validated retinagram_root selects an explicit application root
nodes.rationale: The optional override must be nonempty, absolute and contain both runtime markers. Invalid roots fail clearly; no arbitrary account-directory search or compiled source-root path is used.

nodes.label: run.sh discovers, configures, builds and launches native Windows
nodes.norm_label: run.sh discovers, configures, builds and launches native windows
nodes.rationale: Git Bash/MSYS2 derives the root from BASH_SOURCE and invokes shared PowerShell workflow. Release/Ninja builds use three jobs; --validate/--model-info are awaited, --no-build requires a cache for this root, and incompatible flags fail.

nodes.label: Bounded build/package archival after cache and process checks
nodes.norm_label: bounded build/package archival after cache and process checks
nodes.rationale: CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY detects copied stale caches. --clean archives only build/ninja under an ignored UUID path; app/compiler/Ninja processes block changes, no process is killed, and build/toolchain is preserved. Archives consume space.

nodes.label: S6 gates: inference 14, UI 7, bundle 9 and functional 4 passed
nodes.norm_label: s6 gates: inference 14, ui 7, bundle 9 and functional 4 passed
nodes.rationale: Release builds, CTest 1/1, shell/script parsing, renamed compatible grading artifact, visible GUI, clean-PATH package validation, real Usable CUDA restoration/grade 3, History/Batch controls and Windows report PDFs passed. Local routing remains a small sample.

nodes.label: Preserve model bytes and numerical/output contracts
nodes.norm_label: preserve model bytes and numerical/output contracts
nodes.rationale: Unrelated refactors preserve precision, preprocessing, thresholds, class ordering, warnings and artifact/result names; full masks remain separate from display regions and Top-K.

nodes.label: Local quality/grade agreement does not establish clinical equivalence
nodes.norm_label: local quality/grade agreement does not establish clinical equivalence
nodes.rationale: Six quality/routes and five applicable grades agreed in the historical FP32/native sample; Usable restoration PSNR was 49.71 dB. Sparse BF16 EX masks had zero overlap in two cases.

nodes.label: Total-device CUDA snapshots are not isolated process peaks
nodes.norm_label: total-device cuda snapshots are not isolated process peaks
nodes.rationale: cudaMemGetInfo includes other allocations; WDDM did not expose native process VRAM. PyTorch allocator peaks and Windows RAM measures have different boundaries.

nodes.label: Historical native parity was exact in seven of eight comparisons
nodes.norm_label: historical native parity was exact in seven of eight comparisons
nodes.rationale: GPU Usable differed by at most one restored uint8 level with downstream confidence/CAM/mask differences; repeated original runs also varied. The result is not 8/8 bitwise parity or a clinical tolerance.

nodes.label: Historical three-run sample: warm Good ~14% faster, Usable ~24% slower
nodes.norm_label: historical three-run sample: warm good ~14% faster, usable ~24% slower
nodes.rationale: Observed total times include artifacts and differing timer boundaries. ORT CUDA initializes restoration kernels/shapes on the first Usable run; three-run p95 is not a production latency estimate or current performance guarantee.

nodes.label: Four unchanged production artifacts in src/checkpoints
nodes.norm_label: four unchanged production artifacts in src/checkpoints
nodes.rationale: iqa_int8.onnx is partial QDQ INT8/FP32; nafnet_fp16.onnx uses FP16 internals and FP32 boundary; grade_bf16_cam.pt and lesion_bf16_cam.pt are BF16 TorchScript. src/checkpoints/MODEL_MANIFEST.json records sizes/SHA256; no runtime conversion is needed.

nodes.label: Historical IQA quantization limited after local parity failures
nodes.norm_label: historical iqa quantization limited after local parity failures
nodes.rationale: Broader INT8 candidates changed quality decisions/confidence; selected backbone/classifier layers were quantized and remaining layers stayed FP32.

nodes.label: Historical user-selected FP32-to-BF16 deployment conversion
nodes.rationale: Reference lesion/grading checkpoints contained FP32 tensors; explicit user choice led to separate BF16 deployment files without retraining or altering reference weights.

nodes.label: Windows x64 CUDA tested; Bash orchestration is not Linux/WSL runtime support
nodes.norm_label: windows x64 cuda tested; bash orchestration is not linux/wsl runtime support
nodes.rationale: External SDK installations may need documented overrides and are not vendored. CMake caches are local, archive cleanup consumes space, and historical BF16/FP32/CUDA variability and clinical limits remain.

nodes.label: ReportBundle exports retained complete analyses without reinference
nodes.norm_label: reportbundle exports retained complete analyses without reinference

nodes.label: Unchanged A4 ScreeningReport renderer shared with Batch
nodes.norm_label: unchanged a4 screeningreport renderer shared with batch

nodes.label: Deliberate report-bundle artifacts and relative manifest
nodes.norm_label: deliberate report-bundle artifacts and relative manifest
nodes.rationale: Export writes RGB quality-95 original JPEG, optional actual restored image, copied overlay/full masks, results.json and PDF. It excludes CAM/probability/UI-selection/intermediate files and never recursively copies a run directory.

nodes.label: One bilateral export root with Left_OS and Right_OD
nodes.norm_label: one bilateral export root with left_os and right_od
nodes.rationale: Both COMPLETE eyes must share patient identity. Save Both dispatches one export with one generation instant; a fatal failure in either eye rolls back the new shared root.

nodes.label: Exclusive sanitized patient/time report root
nodes.rationale: An existing selected parent is canonically resolved. Windows-safe 64-unit patient names prevent traversal and exclusive _2/_3 suffixes preserve existing/concurrent exports.

nodes.label: Report preflight and rollback remove only the new root
nodes.norm_label: report preflight and rollback remove only the new root
nodes.rationale: Completion, eye, sources, identity and finite data are checked before allocation. Every directory/copy/JPEG/JSON/PDF write is checked; operation rollback does not promise crash recovery or filesystem transactions.

nodes.label: rememberReportPath updates retained History using checked atomic persistence
nodes.norm_label: rememberreportpath updates retained history using checked atomic persistence
nodes.rationale: Successful GUI export records the matching eye report_path without changing session identity or scan times. Persistence failure is reported separately with the saved report root.

nodes.label: UTF-8 results.json preserves saved analysis values
nodes.norm_label: utf-8 results.json preserves saved analysis values
nodes.rationale: Patient/report metadata, quality/grading, canonical lesions, device/state/source/time use portable references; probabilities are not renormalized, non-finite values fail preflight, and unavailable legacy detection remains null.

nodes.label: Windows-generated PDF QA with conditional restoration
nodes.norm_label: windows-generated pdf qa with conditional restoration
nodes.rationale: Rendered Good/Usable Windows PDFs are typography evidence; offscreen synthetic fonts are unsuitable for that review.

nodes.label: Good/Usable bundle export succeeds with explicit invalid model config
nodes.norm_label: good/usable bundle export succeeds with explicit invalid model config
nodes.rationale: Saved-result export completes without inference initialization; readable one-page A4 PDFs preserve logo, fonts, layout and conditional restoration.

nodes.norm_label: reserved resources; images/fonts in assets and models in src/checkpoints

nodes.norm_label: no blanket application or supplied-model license invented
nodes.rationale: Four deployment models derive from supplied checkpoints; NOTICE preserves provenance and bundled font licenses. External dependency binaries are not committed and retain upstream redistribution obligations.

nodes.norm_label: native cmake build: c++20, qt6, torch, ort and cuda

nodes.label: Publish portable genuine source while excluding local generated data
nodes.norm_label: publish portable genuine source while excluding local generated data
nodes.rationale: Keep patient scans, sessions, raw validation evidence, environments, SDKs, packages, secrets and machine-specific Graphify state out of the branch. Preserve pc-gpu ancestry and historical specs; no force push or default/reference branch replacement.

nodes.label: Historical physical cleanup rejection and ignored original files
nodes.norm_label: historical physical cleanup rejection and ignored original files
nodes.rationale: Automatic approval review blocked physical deletion without a specific reason. Publishable-file copying excluded original generated trees from the publishing worktree; repository cleanup did not physically remove them.

nodes.label: Report tests assert the fixture actual canonical grade
nodes.norm_label: report tests assert the fixture actual canonical grade
nodes.rationale: The former fixed grade-2 assumption was replaced with independently enumerated canonical labels and a range check without changing production inference.

nodes.label: Historical Graphify C++ partial parsing and unavailable host token counts
nodes.norm_label: historical graphify c++ partial parsing and unavailable host token counts
nodes.rationale: The S5 record reports partial AST parsing of RuntimeSupport.cpp, FunctionalSmoke.cpp and UiRegression.cpp despite successful compilation; host semantic token usage is unavailable and is not a free-extraction claim.

nodes.label: Historical ORT DLL selection repair from an older installed runtime
nodes.norm_label: historical ort dll selection repair from an older installed runtime
nodes.rationale: The selected SDK ORT DLLs were copied beside the development executable, preventing installed ONNX Runtime 1.17.1 from being selected.
